You love more than I know how to love.
Help me to see clearly my true needs, which I do not see.
I open my heart to you.
Search me and show me my faults and sins.
I place all my trust in you.
I have no other desire than to do your will.
Teach me to pray.
Pray yourself in me. Amen.

title: Thanksgiving after Trouble
segments: Almighty and merciful God, in all humility and from the depth of my heart I thank your divine majesty for your kindness and tender mercies,
for having heard my humble prayer and graciously delivered me from my trouble and misery.
I ask you, do not cease to grant me your helping grace, that I may lead a life pleasing to you and offer you unceasingly a sacrifice of praise and thanksgiving, Father, Son and Holy Spirit. Amen.

title: Before Work (1)
note: The quotation is John 15:5.
segments: Lord Jesus Christ my God, you said: “Without me you can do nothing.”
With faith I receive your words, O Lord, and I implore your goodness: help me to do the work I am beginning and to bring it to completion.
To you I give glory, to the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit. Amen.

title: Before Work (2)
segments: Almighty God, our Help and Refuge, you know that without your guidance and help we can do nothing good.
Direct me by your wisdom and power, that I may accomplish this task and all that I do according to your divine will,
that it may be useful to me and to others and to the glory of your holy name. Amen.

title: Before Work (3)
segments: My Lord and Savior, you became man and worked with your own hands until the time of your public ministry.
Bless me as I begin this work, and help me to bring it to completion.
Lord, enlighten my mind and strengthen my body, that I may carry out my task according to your will.
Guide me to do good works for your service and glory. Amen.

title: After Work
segments: I thank you, O Lord, for your strength and guidance in my work.
You are the fulfillment of every good thing.
Fill my soul also with joy and gladness, that I may always glorify you. Amen.

title: A Student's Prayer
segments: O Christ my Lord, Giver of light and wisdom, who opened the eyes of the blind man and by the descent of the Holy Spirit made fishermen wise heralds and teachers of the Gospel:
kindle in my mind too the light of the grace of the Holy Spirit.
Give me discernment, understanding and wisdom in my studies.
Let me fulfill my tasks and abound in every good work, for to you I give honor and glory. Amen.

title: Before Study (1)
segments: Most good Lord, send down upon me the grace of your Holy Spirit to strengthen me, that I may learn well what I am to learn,
and so grow into a better person, to your glory, to the comfort of my family, and for the benefit of your Church and our country. Amen.

title: Before Study (2)
note: A prayer from the service of the First Hour.
segments: O Christ, the true Light, who enlighten and sanctify everyone who comes into the world, let the light of your countenance shine upon me, that I may see your unapproachable light;
and direct my steps in the way of your commandments, through the intercession of your most pure Mother and of all the saints. Amen.

title: After Study
segments: I thank you, O Lord our God, that once again you have opened my eyes to the light of your wisdom and gladdened my heart with the knowledge of truth.
I implore you, O Lord, help me always to do your will.
Bless my soul and body, my words and deeds.
Grant me to grow in grace, virtue and good habits, that your name may be glorified, of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, now and forever. Amen.

title: Before Reading Holy Scripture (1)
segments: O Master who love us, kindle in our hearts your eternal light, that we may know you better.
Help us to understand fully the message of your Gospel.
Implant in us reverence for your holy commandments, that, overcoming worldly desires, we may lead a spiritual life, pleasing to you in thought and deed.
We ask this of you, O Christ our God, for you are the light of our souls and bodies,
and we glorify you with your eternal Father and your all-holy, good and life-giving Spirit, now and forever. Amen.

title: Before Reading Holy Scripture (2)
note: A personal form of the prayer the priest says before the Gospel reading at the Divine Liturgy.
segments: Shine in my heart, O Master who love mankind, the pure light of your divine knowledge, and open the eyes of my mind to understand your teachings.
Implant in me also reverence for your blessed commandments, that, having overcome sinful desires, I may lead a spiritual life, thinking and doing all that is pleasing to you.
For you, O Christ my God, are my light, and to you I give glory with your Father and your Holy Spirit, now and forever. Amen.

title: Before a Journey (1)
segments: Lord Jesus Christ my God, be my companion, guide and protector on my journey.
Keep me from every danger, misfortune and temptation.
By your divine power grant me a peaceful and successful journey and a safe arrival.
In you I place my hope and trust, and I glorify, honor and praise you with your Father and the Holy Spirit, now and forever and to the ages of ages. Amen.

title: Before a Journey (2)
segments: Lord Jesus, after your resurrection you walked with two disciples and set their hearts on fire with your grace.
Walk with me too and gladden my heart with your presence.
I know, O Lord, that I am a pilgrim on this earth and seek the citizenship that is in heaven.
On my journey surround me with your holy angels and protect me from dangers seen and unseen.
Grant that I may carry out my plans and fulfill my hopes according to your will.
Help me to see the beauty of creation and to grasp in all things the wonder of your truth.
For you are the way, the truth and the life, and to you I give thanks, honor and glory forever. Amen.

title: A Prayer of Repentance (1)
segments: O God, my good and loving Lord, I confess all the sins I have committed every day of my life, in thought, word or deed.
From the depth of my heart I ask forgiveness for offending you and others, and I repent of my former ways.
Help me by your grace to be transformed, to sin no more, to walk in the way of righteousness, and to praise and glorify your name, of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

title: A Prayer of Repentance (2)
segments: O Lord my God, I confess that I have sinned against you in thought, word and deed.
I have also neglected what your holy law requires of me.
But now with contrition and sorrow I turn again to your love and your mercy.
I implore you, forgive me all my transgressions and cleanse me from all my sins.
O Lord, fill my heart with the light of your truth.
Strengthen my will by your grace.
Teach me to desire and to do only what is pleasing to you. Amen.

title: For Love
segments: O Christ my God, kindle my heart with love for you, that in its flame I may love you with all my heart, with all my mind,
with all my soul and with all my strength, and my neighbor as myself, that by keeping your commandments I may glorify you, the Giver of every good and perfect gift. Amen.

title: A Prayer for Great Lent
note: The prayer behind the ambo from the Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts.
segments: O Master almighty, who made all things in wisdom,
in your providence and great goodness you have brought us to this season of Great Lent, for the cleansing of souls and bodies, for mastery over the passions, in the hope of the resurrection.
You who after forty days gave Moses the tablets of the law written by your divine hand, grant us also strength to fight the good fight,
to persevere in the fast, to keep the faith, to trample down all evil demons, to become victors over sin and to come to celebrate your holy Resurrection.
For blessed and glorified is your all-honorable and majestic name, of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, now and forever and to the ages of ages. Amen.

title: The Prayer of Saint Ephrem the Syrian
note: Said during Great Lent with prostrations.
segments: O Lord and Master of my life, take from me the spirit of sloth, meddling, lust for power and idle talk.
But grant to me, your servant, a spirit of prudence, humility, patience and love.
O Lord and King, grant me to see my own sins and failings and not to judge my brother, for you are blessed to the ages of ages. Amen.

title: Diptychs (Remembering the Living)
note: Each petition is said with a bow. You can make a copy and add the names of your bishop, your spiritual father and your parents.
segments: Remember, O Lord Jesus Christ our God, your mercies and compassions which are from of old,
for whose sake you became incarnate and were pleased to endure crucifixion and death for the salvation of those who truly believe in you,
you rose from the dead, ascended into heaven, sit at the right hand of God the Father and look upon the humble prayers of those who call on you with all their heart.
Incline your ear and hear my humble prayer, the prayer of your useless servant, as a pleasing spiritual fragrance offered to you for all your people.
Above all, remember your holy Church, catholic and apostolic, which you purchased with your precious blood,
strengthen it, establish it, enlarge it, multiply it, grant it peace and keep it forever unconquered by the gates of hell.
Calm the divisions of the Church, quench the assaults of the heathen, quickly destroy the heresies that arise, root them out and bring them to nothing by the power of your Holy Spirit.
Save, O Lord, and have mercy on our most blessed metropolitan, on all the Orthodox patriarchs, metropolitans, archbishops and bishops, on all priests and monastics,
on all the clergy whom you have appointed to shepherd your spiritual flock, and by their prayers have mercy on me and save me, a sinner.
Save, O Lord, and have mercy on my spiritual father, and by his holy prayers forgive my sins.
Save, O Lord, and have mercy on my parents, my brothers and sisters and my relatives according to the flesh,
on my whole family and my friends, and grant them your peace and your heavenly blessings.
Save, O Lord, and have mercy on the old and the young, the poor and the orphans, the widows and those in sickness and trouble, in hardship and sorrow, those captive in prisons and in exile,
and on your servants persecuted by godless heathens, apostates and heretics for your sake and for the Orthodox faith,
and remember them, visit and comfort them, and quickly grant them your mighty consolation, freedom and deliverance.
Save, O Lord, and have mercy on those who hate and insult me and those who attack me, and do not let them perish because of me, a sinner.
Enlighten with the light of your knowledge and unite to your holy, apostolic and catholic Church those who have fallen away from the Orthodox faith and those blinded by destructive heresies.

title: For Our Enemies
segments: Lord Jesus Christ, in your great mercy you prayed for the forgiveness of those who crucified you, and you taught us to love our enemies and to pray for those who persecute us.
O Lord, I ask you, forgive those who treat me unjustly and act against me; bless them and guide them according to your will.
Remove from my heart all bitterness toward them.
O Lord, let your forgiveness, goodness and love be revealed in all of us, to your honor and glory. Amen.

title: For Peace in the World
segments: Almighty God, Creator, you are the Father of all people on earth.
I ask you, guide all nations and their leaders in the ways of justice and peace.
Protect us from the evil of injustice, prejudice, exploitation, conflict and war.
Help us to cast away mistrust, bitterness and hatred.
Teach us to cease storing up and using the instruments of war.
Guide us to find peace, respect and freedom.
Unite us in making and sharing together the tools of peace against ignorance, poverty, disease and oppression.
Grant that we may grow in harmony and friendship as brothers and sisters created in your image, to your honor and glory. Amen.

title: For the Departed (from the Morning Prayers)
note: Said three times, with three bows. You can make a copy and add your parents' names.
segments: Remember, O Lord, the souls of your departed servants, my parents, and all my relatives according to the flesh,
and all our fathers, brothers and sisters who have died in the hope of resurrection and eternal life, and grant them eternal rest.

title: Saturday Prayer for the Departed
note: In the English prayer book, said on Saturday morning, the day of prayer for the departed.
segments: Remember, O Lord, our fathers and brothers who have fallen asleep in the hope of resurrection to eternal life, and all who have ended this life in piety and faith.
Forgive them every transgression, voluntary or involuntary, in word, deed or thought.
Place them in a place of light, a place of refreshment, a place of peace, from which all sickness has fled,
and sorrow and sighing, and where the light of your countenance shines and gladdens all your saints from the ages.
Grant them and us your kingdom.
Give them a share in your ineffable and eternal good things and the joy of your endless and blessed life.
For you are the life, the resurrection and the repose of your departed servants, O Christ our God,
and to you we give glory, with your all-holy, good and life-giving Spirit, now and forever and to the ages of ages. Amen.

title: Kontakion for the Departed: With the Saints Give Rest
segments: With the saints give rest, O Christ, to the souls of your servants, where there is neither pain nor sorrow nor sighing, but life everlasting.

title: For One Who Has Died
note: Praying for someone in particular? Make a copy and add their name after “your departed servant”.
segments: O Christ, eternal King and our God, who by your Cross destroyed death and the devil, and by your Resurrection restored life to mankind:
give rest, O Lord, to the soul of your departed servant in your kingdom, where there is no pain, sorrow or suffering.
In your goodness and love for mankind forgive them all the sins they committed in thought, word or deed,
for there is no one who lives and does not sin; you alone are without sin.
For you are the resurrection, the life and the repose of your departed servant, O Christ our God,
and to you we give glory, with your eternal Father and your all-holy, good and life-giving Spirit, now and forever and to the ages of ages. Amen.

title: For a Child Who Has Died
note: You can make a copy and add the child's name after “your little servant”.
segments: O Lord, who watch over children in this present life and in the world to come because of their simplicity and innocence of mind,
granting them abundantly a place in Abraham's bosom and leading them to places shining with light, where the spirits of the righteous dwell:
receive in peace the soul of your little servant, for you yourself said: “Let the children come to me, for of such is the kingdom of heaven.” Amen.

title: After a Miscarriage
note: A prayer for a mother after a miscarriage. In a copy you can add her name after “this your servant”.
segments: O Master, Lord our God, who were born of the most pure Theotokos and ever-virgin Mary and as an infant were laid in a manger:
look in your great mercy upon this your servant, who has miscarried what was conceived in her.
Heal her suffering, granting her, O Lord who love mankind, health and strength of body and soul.
Guard her through a radiant Angel from every assault of sickness and weakness and from all inner anguish.
You who receive into your kingdom the innocence of infants, comfort the mind of your servant and grant her peace. Amen.
